content.text:
The default persona LLM receives one fixed Egma system frame, the complete persona traits, the current test’s scenario, and the full conversation history. There is no universal final prompt because the scenario changes for every test.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[Test + persona identity] --> B[Run pins exact test and persona versions]
  B --> C[Claim API builds SimulationSpec v3]
  C --> D[Persona: traits + scenario + selected LLM]
  D --> E[Fixed system frame]
  E --> F{Did customer agent speak first?}
  F -- Yes --> G[Add agent words as user]
  F -- No --> H[Add hidden opening nudge as user]
  G --> I[OpenAI chat completion]
  H --> I
  I --> J[Persona reply]
  J --> K{Contains CONCLUDED?}
  K -- No --> L[Speak/send turn, add full history, repeat]
  K -- Yes --> M[Strip marker and end]
  L --> I
  M --> N[Turns/timings become OTLP spans]
  N --> O[Spans land before lifecycle report]
  O --> P[Completed simulation creates grading work]
  P --> Q[Grader reads trace + expected behaviors]
```

The exact default system prompt is:

```text
You are playing a person in a live conversation with a customer service agent. You are the person; the agent is who you are talking to.

Who you are, exactly as authored:

{
  "accent": "Neutral American English.",
  "backgroundNoise": "None.",
  "language": "en-US",
  "manner": "Clear, natural, and conversational.",
  "patience": "Starts patient and gives the agent time to explain.",
  "personality": "Speaks clear, natural English. Starts patient and cooperative, answers one question at a time, and becomes firmer if the agent is confusing or repetitive without becoming rude.",
  "underFriction": "Becomes firmer if the agent is confusing or repetitive, without becoming rude."
}

Why you are here today:

<THE TEST SCENARIO IS INSERTED HERE>

How to conduct yourself:
- Stay in character as this person for the whole exchange. Never mention being simulated, tested, or an AI.
- Speak one conversational turn at a time, in plain spoken words — no lists, no headings, no stage directions.
- Pursue what you came for until it is concluded to your satisfaction, and let your persona decide how patiently.
- When your goal is concluded and nothing further is needed, say a brief goodbye and end your reply with [CONCLUDED].
```

Exact message rules:

- `system`: prompt above.
- `assistant`: every persona/human turn.
- `user`: every customer-agent turn.
- If the customer agent has not spoken, Egma adds this hidden user message:  
  `(The conversation is open and the agent is listening. Speak your first turn.)`
- The hidden nudge is not a transcript turn.
- Every later request contains the complete accumulated history.
- The OpenAI body is only `{ model, messages }`. Egma sends no temperature, token limit, seed, tools, or sampling controls.
- `[CONCLUDED]` is removed before transcript or TTS.

The persona prompt does not receive expected behaviors, grader prompts, customer-agent configuration, organization/project names, connection credentials, mock tools, STT/TTS settings, voice ID, or recordings.

Key source evidence:

- Default traits: `packages/db/src/persona-library/catalog.ts:54-76`
- Run pins exact versions: `packages/db/src/access/runs.ts:685-747`
- Claim builds traits/models/scenario: `apps/api/src/routes/claims.ts:311-470`
- Simulator parses them unchanged: `apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/spec.py:169-244`
- Exact prompt and role mapping: `apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/persona.py:24-84`
- Exact OpenAI request and marker handling: `apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/model.py:179-247`
- Voice Pipecat path: `apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/conductor.py:436-627,815-877`
- Voice opening timing: `apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/conductor.py:977-1072`
- Spans before terminal report: `apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/service.py:375-466`
- Grading handoff: `packages/db/src/access/runs.ts:1793-1834`

One modality difference: voice speaks the final stripped goodbye before ending. Chat records that final turn but exits before sending it to the customer agent (`walk.py:215-226`).
